Pontoon it is. Place your bet on the table below and the dealer will deal.

Rules in brief: both dealer cards stay face-down, and the dealer wins all ties. Twist takes a card, stick stands (only on 15 or better), and buy doubles your stake for a face-down card, repeatable. An Ace with a ten-card is pontoon and pays 2:1. A five-card trick (five cards, 21 or under) beats everything except pontoon. Your bankroll starts at 1,000.
